comparison.objective: Time and execute a utensil-assisted steak flip; candidate tunes and locks an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Utensil manipulation and timed flipping differ from hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, torque control, and repeated impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Steak remains face-down ≥50 s, fully departs by 70 s, and lands opposite-face-down; candidate requires two safe physical carriage stops and post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Timing and food flipping do not test damper commissioning.
